_comment: Reviewed discovery curation. Labels only: scripts/resolve_discovery.py resolves each label to an ontology ID with an exact-label match and writes qspquest_models/discovery.json. A drug without an NCIt concept has ncit null; a target is an HGNC symbol, {"uniprot": accession}, {"chebi": label} or a hypothetical label.
